parsing_rationale: The provided document is not a functional specification but rather a 'Specification Quality Checklist'. It validates whether a specification (referenced as spec.md) is complete. Since the goal is to transform this into a compliance graph for a 'spec' doc type, I have extracted the checklist items as constraints and requirements for the specification process itself. However, the actual business logic for 'Sales Item Management' is missing from this file, leading to significant structural gaps.

project_info.brief_explanation: Quality assurance checklist to validate the completeness of the Sales Item Management specification.

sections.title: Specification Quality Checklist: Sales Item Management System

**Created**: 2026-08-12

sections.title: Notes

elements.content: Specification must contain no implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs).
Specification must be focused on user value and business needs.
No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers must remain in the document.
Requirements must be testable and unambiguous.
Success criteria must be measurable and technology-agnostic.
All functional requirements must have clear acceptance criteria and user scenarios covering primary flows.

structural_gaps.remediation_advice: The document is a checklist; the actual scope of the Sales Item Management system is missing. Please provide the spec.md file.
While the checklist mentions clarification markers, the actual open questions of the project are not listed.
